title: STRONG PREFERENCES AFFECT THE ROBUSTNESS OF PREFERENCE MODELS AND VALUE ALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical robustness and sensitivity of preference models (Bradley-Terry and Plackett-Luce) used for AI value alignment. Although it mentions alignment with 'human values' and provides an illustrative example of harmful content rejection in the appendix, the primary work is a technical analysis of model stability rather than a systematic evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical reasoning.
